nodes.name: Asana
nodes.description: Physical postures.

nodes.name: Pranayama
nodes.description: Breath regulation.

passages.heading: Bee Breath for Nervous System
passages.text: Hum on exhale with ears plugged. Stimulate vagus nerve. Instant calm. Great for anxiety.

passages.heading: Right Nostril Activation
passages.text: Inhale right, exhale left. Activate pingala, solar energy, digestive fire. Morning energy boost.

passages.heading: Left Nostril Cooling
passages.text: Inhale left, exhale right. Activate ida, lunar energy, cooling. Evening wind-down.

passages.heading: Breath Retention Art
passages.text: Progressive breath holds. Build CO2 tolerance, access deeper states. Advanced practitioners only.

passages.heading: Primordial Sound
passages.text: A-U-M resonance. Align with cosmic vibration. The orb visualizes each frequency band.

passages.heading: Scientific Breath Holds
passages.text: Evidence-based protocol. Increase BOLT score. Improve oxygen delivery, reduce anxiety.

passages.heading: Relearn Natural Breathing
passages.text: Most adults breathe wrong. Restore 360° diaphragmatic breathing. Foundation for all practices.

passages.heading: Complete 45-Minute Practice
passages.text: Kapalabhati → Nadi Shodhana → Bhramari → Ujjayi → Meditation. Traditional sequence.

passages.heading: 4-7-8 Emergency Protocol
passages.text: Inhale 4, hold 7, exhale 8. Activate parasympathetic in 90 seconds. Keep this bookmarked.

passages.heading: Evening Wind-Down Sequence
passages.text: Chandra Bhedana → Sheetali → Bhramari → Long Exhales. Prepare for deep rest.

passages.heading: Anapanasati Foundation
passages.text: Buddha's core teaching. Watch breath at the nostrils. Return when distracted. Simple, not easy.

passages.heading: Vipassana Body Sweep
passages.text: Systematic attention through the body. Sensations as they are. Equanimity training.

passages.heading: Metta Bhavana
passages.text: May I be happy. May you be happy. May all beings be happy. Expand circles of care.

passages.heading: Transform Suffering
passages.text: Breathe in others' pain, breathe out relief. Advanced compassion practice. Not for beginners.

passages.heading: Dzogchen / Mahamudra
passages.text: Rest in naked awareness. No object. No effort. The orb dissolves into the space of knowing.

passages.heading: Crystal Bowls & Gongs
passages.text: Immersive frequencies. The orb visualizes each harmonic. Deep relaxation through vibration.

passages.heading: Kinhin Practice
passages.text: Slow, deliberate steps. Sync breath to movement. The orb tracks your pace.

passages.heading: Maranasati Contemplation
passages.text: This breath could be the last. Urgency. Clarity. What matters? The orb counts down.

passages.heading: Cultivate Appreciation
passages.text: Three things. Feel each deeply. Rewire negativity bias. The orb glows with each gratitude.

passages.heading: Release Resentment
passages.text: Ask forgiveness, offer forgiveness, forgive yourself. Heavy burden, light heart.

passages.heading: Reparenting Meditation
passages.text: Meet your younger self. Offer what was needed. Integrate fragmented parts.

passages.heading: Seven Energy Centers
passages.text: Root to Crown. Bija mantras, colors, elements. The orb cycles through each center.

passages.heading: Deep Concentration States
passages.text: Access 1st-4th jhana. Bliss, joy, equanimity, purity. For serious practitioners.

passages.heading: Trataka + Breath
passages.text: Candle gazing then breath focus. Train single-pointed attention. Productivity superpower.

passages.heading: Grounding & Safety
passages.text: 5-4-3-2-1 senses. Breath anchor. Resource installation. The orb as safe container.

passages.heading: Ramana Maharshi's Direct Path
passages.text: Turn attention to the 'I' thought. Find its source. The orb reflects the inquiry.

passages.heading: Nisargadatta's Pointer
passages.text: Abide in 'I Am' prior to 'I am this'. The sense of being. The orb holds the space.

passages.heading: Rupert Spira's Method
passages.text: That which knows experience. Turn knowing back on itself. The orb as mirror.

passages.heading: Douglas Harding's Experiment
passages.text: Point at where others see your face. See no-thing. The orb reveals the void.

passages.heading: Four Questions Turnaround
passages.text: Is it true? Can you absolutely know? How do you react? Who without it? Turn it around.

passages.heading: Release Technique
passages.text: Could you let it go? Would you? When? The orb visualizes emotional release.

passages.heading: Jungian Integration
passages.text: Meet disowned parts. Projection withdrawal. Golden shadow. The orb illuminates darkness.

passages.heading: Internal Family Systems
passages.text: Identify protectors, exiles, Self. Unblend. Heal. The orb represents Self-energy.

passages.heading: Dukkha Investigation
passages.text: Where is the suffering? Who suffers? Can you find it? The orb dissolves the story.

passages.heading: Eckhart Tolle's Now
passages.text: One conscious breath. Feel the inner body. Watch the thinker. The orb anchors now.

passages.heading: 12-Pose Flow
passages.text: Salute the sun. 12 poses, breath-synchronized. The orb paces each movement.

passages.heading: Cooling Evening Flow
passages.text: Lateral movements, gentle inversions. Honor the moon. The orb glows lunar.

passages.heading: Emotional Release
passages.text: Pigeon, lizard, frog. Hips store emotion. Breathe through intensity. The orb holds space.

passages.heading: Camel, Wheel, Bridge
passages.text: Counteract sitting. Open front body. Vulnerability as strength. The orb expands with each arch.

passages.heading: Headstand, Shoulderstand
passages.text: Change perspective. Refresh circulation. Build confidence. The orb inverts with you.

passages.heading: Long Holds, Deep Release
passages.text: 3-5 minute holds. Target connective tissue. Meditation in discomfort. The orb times each pose.

passages.heading: Supported Relaxation
passages.text: Props everywhere. Zero effort. Nervous system reset. The orb as sanctuary.

passages.heading: Beyond Crunches
passages.text: Deep core: transverse, pelvic floor, diaphragm. Functional strength. The orb engages with you.

passages.heading: Tree, Eagle, Warrior III
passages.text: One-legged stability. Focus drishti. Fall, retry. The orb wobbles with you.

passages.heading: Psychic Sleep
passages.text: Rotation of consciousness. Sankalpa. Hypnagogic healing. The orb guides the journey.

passages.heading: Build Your Practice
passages.text: Day 1: Breath → Day 2: Body → Day 3: Mind → Day 4: Heart → Day 5: Inquiry → Day 6: Integration → Day 7: Lifestyle.

passages.heading: Rewire Your Baseline
passages.text: Progressive intensity. Habit formation. Community accountability. The orb tracks your streak.

passages.heading: Deepen Beyond Habit
passages.text: Three phases: Establish → Deepen → Embody. Guru guidance. Retreat integration. Lifetime access.

passages.heading: Nervous System Mastery
passages.text: Polyvagal theory applied. Vagal toning. Window of tolerance expansion. The orb as biofeedback.

passages.heading: Feel, Name, Navigate
passages.text: Granularity. Regulation. Empathy. Leadership application. The orb reflects emotional weather.

passages.heading: Access Genius
passages.text: Transient hypofrontality. Dopamine management. Deep work blocks. The orb as flow trigger.

passages.heading: Circadian Mastery
passages.text: Light, temperature, timing, supplements, wind-down. The orb tracks sleep architecture.

passages.heading: Attachment & Communication
passages.text: Attachment styles. Non-violent communication. Rupture & repair. The orb for couples.

passages.heading: Money & Meaning
passages.text: Psychology of money. Enoughness. Generosity. Values-based spending. The orb as abundance.

passages.heading: Ikigai & Dharma
passages.text: What you love, what you're good at, what world needs, what pays. The orb reveals dharma.

passages.heading: Growing Life
passages.text: Safe modifications. Birth preparation. Connect with baby. The orb pulses with two hearts.

passages.heading: Fourth Trimester
passages.text: Pelvic floor. Diastasis. Hormones. Identity shift. The orb holds the new mother.

passages.heading: Chair & Standing
passages.text: Joint mobility. Balance. Breath. Independence. The orb moves slowly, patiently.

passages.heading: Performance Optimization
passages.text: HRV tracking. Parasympathetic activation. Tissue quality. Mental game. The orb as coach.

passages.heading: Choice & Agency
passages.text: Invitational language. No hands-on. Exit anytime. The orb as safe witness.

passages.heading: Neuroplasticity Approach
passages.text: Pain reprocessing. Sensation vs suffering. Graded exposure. The orb as distraction tool.

passages.heading: 12-Step Integration
passages.text: Urge surfing. Inventory. Amends. Service. The orb tracks sober time.

passages.heading: Tend the Wound
passages.text: Waves of grief. Continuing bonds. Meaning reconstruction. The orb holds the darkness.

passages.heading: Fill Your Cup First
passages.text: Compassion fatigue. Boundaries. Micro-respite. Guilt release. The orb as sanctuary.

passages.heading: Conscious Dying
passages.text: Life review. Forgiveness. Legacy. Letting go. The orb as companion.

passages.heading: Weight
passages.text: Let the seat carry your whole weight. You do not have to hold yourself up.

passages.heading: Contact
passages.text: Feel exactly where the body touches what holds it — seat, feet, hands.

passages.heading: One Field
passages.text: Now stop dividing. Feel the body as a single weight, breathing.

passages.heading: Air
passages.text: Notice the temperature of the air wherever skin is exposed.

passages.heading: Difference
passages.text: Find one place that is warmer and one that is cooler.

passages.heading: Both
passages.text: Hold both at once. Warm and cool, in the same body.

passages.heading: Five Points
passages.text: Feet, hands, seat, back, jaw. Touch each with attention, one at a time.

passages.heading: The Quiet Ones
passages.text: Which point had gone unnoticed until now?

passages.heading: Whole
passages.text: Let attention rest on all five at once, like a hand on a wide table.

passages.heading: Belly
passages.text: Place a hand on the belly. Feel it move on its own.

passages.heading: Rise and Fall
passages.text: Follow three movements without controlling them.

passages.heading: Let Go
passages.text: Remove the hand. The belly still knows how.

passages.heading: Near
passages.text: Find the closest sound. Do not name it. Just let it be heard.

passages.heading: Far
passages.text: Now the farthest sound you can find.

passages.heading: Field
passages.text: Let near and far exist together, with no preference.

passages.heading: Edges
passages.text: Feel where the body ends and the air begins.

passages.heading: Blur
passages.text: Notice that the edge is not a line. It is a soft zone.

passages.heading: No Edge
passages.text: For a few breaths, stop locating yourself in a body.

passages.heading: Hands
passages.text: Rest the hands. Let them be heavy.

passages.heading: Stillness
passages.text: Find the stillness inside the hands, not around them.

passages.heading: Whole Body
passages.text: That same stillness is in the feet, the face, the chest.

passages.heading: Jaw
passages.text: Let the jaw be slightly apart. Feel the space appear.

passages.heading: Shoulders
passages.text: Drop them a centimetre. Notice what was holding them.

passages.heading: Map
passages.text: Scan for any other place still bracing for something.

passages.heading: Head
passages.text: Feel the weight of the head resting on the neck.

passages.heading: Balance
passages.text: Notice the small adjustments keeping it upright.

passages.heading: Let Go
passages.text: Let the neck carry it. Stop helping.

passages.heading: Fabric
passages.text: Feel the cloth on your skin — texture, pressure, fold.

passages.heading: Changes
passages.text: Notice the places where the cloth moves with the breath.

passages.heading: Skin
passages.text: Now feel the skin under it, not the cloth.

passages.heading: Fingertips
passages.text: Bring attention to the pads of the fingers.

passages.heading: Pulse
passages.text: Find the smallest pulse or throb there.

passages.heading: Life
passages.text: That rhythm has been running your whole life without applause.

passages.heading: Feet
passages.text: Feel both feet, the floor pressing back.

passages.heading: Step
passages.text: Imagine one slow step. Feel the weight shift before it happens.

passages.heading: Walking
passages.text: For a few breaths, walk nowhere, in your mind, just feeling the feet.

passages.heading: Field
passages.text: Stop scanning parts. Let the whole body be one field of sensation.

passages.heading: No Labels
passages.text: Drop the words body, leg, chest. Just the field.

passages.heading: Rest
passages.text: Rest in the field without needing to know what it is.

passages.heading: Already Breathing
passages.text: Notice that the breath is happening without an instruction.

passages.heading: Who
passages.text: See if you can find the one doing it.

passages.heading: Rest
passages.text: Let the question go. Stay with the breathing.

passages.heading: Count
passages.text: Count ten breaths silently on each exhale: one, two, three…

passages.heading: Lose It
passages.text: If you lose count, start again at one. No penalty.

passages.heading: Ten
passages.text: Complete one full round to ten without losing it.

passages.heading: Don't Change
passages.text: Watch the next breath exactly as it is — short, long, rough, easy.

passages.heading: Signature
passages.text: Find what is unique about this breath compared to the last.

passages.heading: Allow
passages.text: Let the breath decide its own rhythm for the rest of the sitting.

passages.heading: Nostrils
passages.text: Feel the air at the nostrils, cool in, warm out.

passages.heading: Edge
passages.text: Find the exact point where the air enters.

passages.heading: Cave
passages.text: Follow the air a little way inside. No further.

passages.heading: Belly
passages.text: Feel the belly move first on the next inhale.

passages.heading: Chest
passages.text: Then notice the chest. Which moved first this time?

passages.heading: Compare
passages.text: Do not correct it. Just know what actually happened.

passages.heading: Pause
passages.text: After the exhale, do not rush the next inhale.

passages.heading: Gap
passages.text: Notice the small pause that is already there.

passages.heading: Rest
passages.text: Let the pause lengthen on its own.

passages.heading: Inhale Four
passages.text: Breathe in for four silent counts.

passages.heading: Exhale Six
passages.text: Breathe out for six. Let the exhale be longer.

passages.heading: Rhythm
passages.text: Keep 4–6 for eight rounds without forcing.

passages.heading: Sound
passages.text: Hear the breath itself — the small sound at the nostrils.

passages.heading: Texture
passages.text: Is it smooth, rasping, wet, dry?

passages.heading: Merge
passages.text: Let the sound and the sensation be one event.

passages.heading: Back
passages.text: Feel the breath in the back of the body, behind the ribcage.

passages.heading: Wide
passages.text: Let the inhale widen the back, not the chest.

passages.heading: Rest
passages.text: Feel the back breathe on its own.

passages.heading: Equal
passages.text: Make the in-breath and out-breath the same length.

passages.heading: Count
passages.text: Count silently: in 4, out 4, for six rounds.

passages.heading: Natural
passages.text: Then release the count and let the rhythm settle.
